info.name: Synapse Order Router
info.description: Manual test requests for `POST /api/route` against the real catalog in `data/`. Every route response is HTTP 200; check `feasible`. Set `baseUrl` to the running server.

item.name: Successful routing
item.description: Feasible orders routed against the real catalog.

request.description:
Sample order ORD-001: a wheelchair and an oxygen concentrator at ZIP 10015 with mail order off. Expect `feasible: true` with one shipment from SUP-0636, both line items `local` (BR-016, BR-023).

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/route -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"order_id":"ORD-001","customer_zip":"10015","mail_order":false,"items":[{"product_code":"WC-STD-001","quantity":1},{"product_code":"OX-PORT-024","quantity":1}]}'
```

Sample order ORD-002: four product categories at ZIP 77059 with mail order off. Expect one shipment from SUP-0928 covering all four line items (BR-016).

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/route -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"order_id":"ORD-002","customer_zip":"77059","mail_order":false,"items":[{"product_code":"HB-FUL-018","quantity":1},{"product_code":"PL-ELEC-043","quantity":1},{"product_code":"CM-BED-048","quantity":1},{"product_code":"BP-AUTO-077","quantity":1}]}'
```

Sample order ORD-003 at leading-zero ZIP 02130 with mail order on. Expect SUP-023 with every line item `mail_order`: a clearly higher satisfaction score beats local preference (BR-008, BR-013, BR-017, BR-019).

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/route -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"order_id":"ORD-003","customer_zip":"02130","mail_order":true,"items":[{"product_code":"CP-STD-031","quantity":1},{"product_code":"CP-MSK-FF-035","quantity":2},{"product_code":"NB-COMP-039","quantity":1}]}'
```

The same order as 03a with mail order off. Only suppliers serving ZIP 02130 qualify, so expect SUP-0960 with every line item `local` (BR-012).

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/route -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"order_id":"ORD-003","customer_zip":"02130","mail_order":false,"items":[{"product_code":"CP-STD-031","quantity":1},{"product_code":"CP-MSK-FF-035","quantity":2},{"product_code":"NB-COMP-039","quantity":1}]}'
```

Two lines for WC-STD-001 (quantities 1 and 2). Expect a single WC-STD-001 line item with quantity 3, assigned to one supplier (BRX-006, BRX-007, BR-027).

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/route -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"order_id":"DUP-1","customer_zip":"10015","mail_order":false,"items":[{"product_code":"WC-STD-001","quantity":1},{"product_code":"WC-STD-001","quantity":2}]}'
```

Order ID, ZIP, and product code padded with spaces, plus an unknown `priority` field. Expect normal routing: whitespace is trimmed and the extra field has no effect (BRX-016, BR-009).

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/route -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"order_id":"  TRIM-1 ","customer_zip":" 10015 ","mail_order":false,"items":[{"product_code":" WC-STD-001 ","quantity":1}],"priority":"rush"}'
```

item.name: Location and mail order
item.description: ZIPs below 00100 have no supplier serving them locally in the real catalog.

item.name: 06 No local supplier, mail order off

request.description:
ZIP 00050 with mail order off. No supplier serves this ZIP, so expect `feasible: false` with one "No eligible supplier" error per line item and no partial routing (BR-012, BR-026, BRX-009).

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/route -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"order_id":"GEO-1","customer_zip":"00050","mail_order":false,"items":[{"product_code":"WC-STD-001","quantity":1},{"product_code":"OX-PORT-024","quantity":1}]}'
```

item.name: 07 No local supplier, mail order on

request.description:
The same order as 06 with mail order on. Expect SUP-047 with both line items `mail_order` (BR-013, BRX-014).

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/route -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"order_id":"GEO-2","customer_zip":"00050","mail_order":true,"items":[{"product_code":"WC-STD-001","quantity":1},{"product_code":"OX-PORT-024","quantity":1}]}'
```

item.name: Orders that cannot be routed
item.description: Valid requests that produce an infeasible routing decision.

request.description:
Two unknown product codes alongside a valid one. Expect `feasible: false` with one "Unknown product code" error each and no partial routing (BRX-013, BRX-009, BR-026).

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/route -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"order_id":"UNK-1","customer_zip":"10015","mail_order":false,"items":[{"product_code":"NOPE-1","quantity":1},{"product_code":"WC-STD-001","quantity":1},{"product_code":"NOPE-2","quantity":1}]}'
```

Product codes match exactly after trimming, so `wc-std-001` is reported as an unknown product code (BRX-013).

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/route -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"order_id":"CASE-1","customer_zip":"10015","mail_order":false,"items":[{"product_code":"wc-std-001","quantity":1}]}'
```

Two WC-STD-001 lines whose total exceeds the largest exactly representable integer. Expect "Total quantity for WC-STD-001 is too large." (BRX-019).

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/route -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"order_id":"QTY-1","customer_zip":"10015","mail_order":false,"items":[{"product_code":"WC-STD-001","quantity":9007199254740991},{"product_code":"WC-STD-001","quantity":1}]}'
```

item.name: Invalid input
item.description: Every response is still HTTP 200 with `feasible: false` (BR-022, BR-024).

request.description:
Empty order ID, four-digit ZIP, string mail-order flag, empty product code, and zero quantity. Expect five errors reported together (BR-025, BR-026, BRX-010).

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/route -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"order_id":"","customer_zip":"1234","mail_order":"yes","items":[{"product_code":"","quantity":0}]}'
```

An order with no line items. Expect "items: Order must include at least one line item." (BR-025).

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/route -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"order_id":"EMPTY-1","customer_zip":"10015","mail_order":false,"items":[]}'
```

A body that is not valid JSON. Expect "Request body must contain valid JSON." (BR-024).

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/route -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{bad json'
```

Valid JSON that is not an order object. Expect "order: Invalid input: expected object, received array" (BR-024).

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/route -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '[]'
```

A `text/plain` body is not parsed as JSON. Expect an `order: …` validation error (BR-024).

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/route -H 'Content-Type: text/plain' \
  -d 'hello'
```

Returns the OpenAPI 3.1 document. Expect HTTP 200.

```bash
curl http://localhost:3000/openapi.json
```

Serves the Swagger UI docs page. Expect HTTP 200.

```bash
curl http://localhost:3000/docs
```
